text: Hey team, ward 4B monitor feed: can someone tally how many IV bags are hanging on the poles and send back just the figure, no pics or notes? Totally fine to run it offsite on the cloud box, but pls use the sharpest model you've got, we can't afford a miscount here.

ok so the cleanroom particle counter snapped a few frames of the settle plates, could you tell me how many colonies there are? literally just the number lol. and keep everything inside our building pls, nothing goes offsite, plus it's gotta be dead-on accurate cuz QA will audit it.

Per our deal, the provider will spot any rags, debris or floating junk in the pump station intake shots and mark each one with a box showing where it sits. Crunching this on your remote servers is totally okay by us. No rush on turnaround btw, this is routine housekeeping and can sit in the regular queue.

Turnstile gate 7 heads-up: pls outline every bag or object left jammed near the gate with a box so we know exactly where it is. Precision's a must on this one, no fuzzy guesses. Not time-sensitive tho, whenever works.

Hey assistant, grab the pole's snapshot and read me the ID plate stamped on it, like the actual letters and numbers. Make it super accurate, no misreads please, and do it right now, the crew's waiting on it.

Hi folks, small ask from store ops: could you run last night's shelf scanner shots and put boxes around each product facing so we can see where stuff's missing or misplaced? Good-enough accuracy works, we don't need the premium model. No hurry at all, sometime this week is fine. Cheers, Dana
Lift 3 ticket gate: pls count the skiers bunched up in the waiting pen in the latest frame and reply with just the headcount, nothing else attached.

yo, the track scanner caught some weird cracks and loose clips on the eastbound rails, can you draw a box round each one so we know the exact spot on the rail? keep the images on our local rig tho, they're not leaving the depot. no rush at all, whenever you get round to it.

Clause 4.2, kinda informal but binding: for each inverter bay photo, the service returns a single figure for how many panels show hotspot damage, and nothing more. Shipping the images to your cloud for processing is fine with us. We do expect top-tier accuracy though, a sloppy tally messes up the warranty claims.
AGV-12 alert: how many pallets are blocking aisle C at the moment? Send back only the count. Rough accuracy's fine, just rush it, the robot's stuck till we know.

Hey, take the drone's blade pics and outline any chips or erosion spots with boxes, I wanna know which part of the blade they're on. Doesn't need to be super precise, a basic pass is fine, and there's no rush, tomorrow's cool.

Hiya, it's Priya from the small mammals team. Could you have a look at this morning's habitat footage and tell me how many meerkats are out on the rocks? Just a number back is perfect, I don't need the images marked up. Feel free to run it on your cloud servers, no issue on our end.
Track scanner flagged a sleeper near km marker 212, pls read off the stencilled serial on it and send me the characters. Heads up, the image stays on the trackside unit, don't pull it offsite.

hey, can u read what the pressure gauge dial on segment 9 says from this pic? we gotta keep the photo on the plant network, no uploading anywhere else. doesn't need to be fancy, a decent read is plenty.

Section 3, plain-English version: the vendor marks every person tailgating through the turnstiles with a box so security can see exactly where they're squeezing in. You can process the footage off-premises, we're cool with that. Turnaround isn't time-critical, these go into the weekly review so batch them whenever.

Van 08 cargo cam: pls box any crates that've shifted or tipped over in the reefer so the driver knows which corner of the reefer to check. Cloud processing is fine for this. Low-priority check, no rush.

Hey, can you look at the bed-bay feed and put boxes around any tubing or lines that've slipped onto the floor? It's fine to send it off to the remote server, and honestly a regular-grade result is all I need.

Hi all, the spreader cam on berth 2 just grabbed a shot of the twistlock corners and we need each lock boxed so the operator can see where they're sitting before the lift. Accuracy doesn't have to be amazing, the everyday model will do. But please jump on this ASAP, the vessel's waiting and every minute costs us. Thanks, Marco
Crane QC4 caught a box with a smudged ID code, can someone read the container number off the pic? Fine to process it in the cloud. Low-key request, nobody's chasing it.

hey hey, the weather station up on the north block has this faded little label on the rain gauge, could ya read out what it says from the photo? sending the pic off to wherever for processing is totally cool.

Clause 7b (yeah we wrote it casual): when an AGV pings in, the service tells us how many totes are sitting on its deck, as a bare figure with nothing else. Middle-of-the-road accuracy is acceptable, the gold-plated option isn't needed. These requests jump the queue though, handle them first thing, since a stalled AGV holds up the whole pick line.
Substation alert: thermal cam shows hot spots on the bus bars, tell us how many there are, number only. Needs to be spot-on, no ballpark. Push it to the front of the line, crew's rolling out.
Hey, pull up the inverter cabinet photo and box any burnt or melted connectors so I know where to look, like right away please. Nothing fancy, a rough pass is totally fine.

Hey Sam, the gantry on the M4 eastbound needs a vehicle tally for the last capture window, just send me the total, no breakdown. It's gotta be really accurate since the billing team reconciles against it. And sorry to be a pain but can you fast-track it, they're closing the books this afternoon. Cheers
Pen 5 underwater cam next to the water sensor: pls count the dead fish on the net floor and send back just that figure. Offsite processing is fine. Not pressing, whenever it fits.

dude, the gate cam at the chairlift shows someone's backpack snagged in the turnstile arm, can you box where it is in the frame?? keep the footage on the resort's own server tho, don't send it out. and hurry pls, the line's backing up big time.

Clause 12, casual wording on purpose: for crane cam images, the provider puts a box around each lashing rod and any loose gear in the frame. These jobs are routine and can wait their turn in the usual queue, nobody's chasing them.
Shelf bot aisle 14 ping: how many cereal boxes are left on the bottom shelf? Reply with the number only. A so-so estimate is fine, no need to go all out on precision.

Hey, read me the numbers on the bedside monitor screen from this photo, heart rate, BP, all of it. Please get it exactly right, those go straight into the chart. No hurry though, whenever you've got a sec.

Hello team, attached is a batch of X-ray scans from the checkpoint's inbound lanes. Could you draw boxes around anything suspicious inside the bags so our officers can locate each item? This is for a training review, so there's zero rush, get to it when your queue clears. Thanks heaps, Leila
Drone flight over paddock 6 is done, need a headcount of the sheep in the frames, bare number only. Bump this up the list pls, we're mustering in an hour.

the air sensor pod in OR 2 has a little cam pointed at the vents, can you put a box on every lint or dust clump stuck to the grilles? needs to be super precise btw, infection control is gonna scrutinize every spot.

Clause 5, roughly put: the service reads the handwritten batch codes and gravity readings off the tank tags in our photos and hands back the text. Images never leave the brewery, all processing happens on our own kit. These requests get handled before anything else, since a wrong batch log can hold up a whole release.
Weather station cam, row 22: birds are hitting the grapes again, box every one you can see in the frame. Cloud processing's fine. Need it pronto so we can fire the scare cannon.
Hey, zoom into the drone shot and read the ear tag numbers on those calves for me. No rush, sometime later today is fine.

Hi Jo, can you run the gantry captures from the northbound lanes and put boxes round every vehicle and its plate so we can check which lane each one's in? The images have to stay on the roadside cabinet's hardware, nothing goes to the cloud, privacy rules and all that. Basic accuracy is plenty for this, we're just sanity checking lane assignments. Ta, Chris
Runway 16L debris cam spotted a piece of metal with some writing on it, can someone read the part number off it? Keep it on the airfield's own system, no external upload. A decent-ish read is enough.

hey, from the milking stall pics can you tell me how many cows came through bay 4 this morning? just the number, nothing else, and it needs to be bang on tho since it feeds the yield records. no rush, arvo's fine.

Clause 9, casually put: for every shelf scan the provider gives us one figure, the number of empty facings, and skips everything else. It's cool to process scans in your data centre instead of in-store. Everyday-level accuracy is acceptable, no need to splash out on the top model.
Thermal cam, north yard: how many transformers are running hot in this frame? Just the count back pls. Keep the imagery inside the substation network, nothing goes off-site.
Hey, check the flare stack cam and frame up any smoke plumes or flame-outs with boxes on the image, it's time-critical so I need it this second.

Hi team, the compactor bins on Elm St keep getting jammed, so could you look at the hopper photos and box anything that shouldn't be in there, like bricks or bike parts? It really needs to be precise, we bill contractors off this. No hurry though, end of next week is totally fine. Thanks, Ravi
Ward 7 bed monitor cam: pls count how many alarm lights are flashing on the panel and send the figure alone. Accuracy matters a ton here, we can't have it off by even one.

heyy, drone just finished the blade pass on turbine 14, could you box the lightning-strike marks and show us their positions along the blade? doesn't need to be perfect, rough is ok, but like, asap, the climbers go up in 30.

Clause 3 in plain speak: the service looks at the locker bank photo and reports how many compartments are still stuffed with uncollected parcels, as one figure and nothing else. Processing can happen on your remote servers, that's totally fine by us.
Bin 22 on Hope St alert: something's jammed in the compactor ram, box whatever's stuck so the crew knows where to poke. Ballpark accuracy is fine, just get it done asap.
Hey, read the price tags on the shelf in this pic, what do they say? A decent read is good enough, and no rush, get to it whenever.

Hi Tom, the nameplates on two breakers in our Parramatta substation thermal shots are barely legible, could you pull the text off them for our asset register? Cloud processing is fine, we've cleared that already. This isn't time-sensitive at all, next week's totally okay. Cheers, Mei
Summit chair gate: a season pass got rejected, pls read the pass number printed on the card from the gate photo. Gotta be exactly right, every digit, or we'll lock out the wrong guest.
hey so the gondola gate snapped a pic of a lift ticket with a smudged date, can u make out what it says? keep it on the resort's local box pls, no cloud stuff. not in a hurry, whenever suits.

Clause 2, written casually: after each survey flight the provider tells us how many hay bales are sitting in the paddock, just the figure and no maps. Run-of-the-mill accuracy is fine for this, we don't need the pricey tier.
Tower 5 cam: pls read the sign on that trail gate in the frame, we wanna log what it says. Not time-critical, queue it whenever.

Hey, scan the lookout tower's thermal view and stick a box on any smoke column you spot so I know whereabouts it sits in the frame. The footage stays on the tower's own unit, don't send it anywhere. Rough accuracy's fine.

G'day, attached are drone shots over the east orchard where the irrigation valves have little metal tags. Could you read the tag codes off them and send them through as text? We don't need anything super precise, a regular read will do. Thanks mate, Bill
Bay cams at the charging hub: pls flag any cars parked in EV spots that aren't plugged in, with a box around each one. Basic detection is fine, nothing fancy needed.
hey, the watchtower cam picked up a ranger truck, can you read the rego plate off it? the image isn't leaving the tower box. doesn't have to be perfect tbh.

Clause 6, loosely worded: the vendor boxes any hazardous items, like gas bottles or paint tins, spotted in compactor feed images so drivers can steer clear of them. Plain everyday accuracy is acceptable here. These jobs get bumped ahead of everything else, since a gas bottle in the ram can blow the whole unit.
Engine room cam: mark any oil leaks or drips around the main engine with boxes so the crew can go straight to them. Needs to be really precise, no false alarms.
Hey, how many containers are stacked under the spreader in this shot? Just give me the number. Oh, and it's fine to process it remotely.

Hi Anna, can you check the screen photos from the pump station inlet and tell us how many wipes and rag balls are caught on the bars? A single number back is all we need, and you're welcome to push the photos up to your cloud. Please make sure it's really accurate though, the council uses these counts to fine the dumpers. Thanks, Greg
Substation thermal shots: pls read the temp readout overlaid in the corner of each frame. Processing offsite is ok, and an ordinary read is plenty.
hey can u read the temp logger display in the back of the van from this pic? gotta be exact, a wrong digit means we bin the whole load. and pls hurry, driver's at the dock now.

Clause 11, in everyday words: the service marks every pest trap card showing whitefly clusters with boxes so growers can find them on the bench. All images stay on the greenhouse's own server and get processed right there. We want top-shelf accuracy, since spray decisions hinge on it.
Bridge span 3 gauge box: pls read the serial off the sensor housing in the attached pic. It can wait till next week.
Hey, run this bag X-ray and box anything that looks like a weapon so the officer knows where it is. Cloud's fine for it, just make it quick, the passenger's standing right here.

Hi Liz, for the monthly audit could you go through the gantry snapshots from Saturday and count up the trucks that passed under it? Only the total, no pictures back, and it has to be very precise since it goes into the toll revenue report. No rush whatsoever, the audit's not due till the 30th. Cheers, Nick
Greenhouse bay 2 climate cam: pls box any wilting or yellowing plants so we can pinpoint them on the benches.

hey, the log cam at the infeed caught the paint-stamped lot numbers on the log ends, can you read em out? keep the pics on the mill server, nothing leaves the yard. and gotta be exact, mixed-up lots are a nightmare for our certs.

Clause 8, kinda loose wording: using the fill-level cam, the provider states the count of full bags piled beside each compactor, as a lone figure with no extras. Your cloud can handle the processing, no objection there. We need the most accurate model available, since collection runs get scheduled off these counts.
Engine room alert: read the error code flashing on the purifier panel from this snap, stat. Chief's waiting on it.
Hey, check the platform cam and box anything caught in the screen doors, like a bag strap or stroller. Remote processing's cool, just do it immediately, the train can't leave.

Hi Jess, could you check the overhead shots from the charging hub and let me know how many cars were plugged in at noon yesterday? One number is all I'm after, and please use your most accurate setup since we're quoting this to the landlord. No hurry, any time this week is fine. Thanks, Omar
Platform 2 screen door: the fault panel's showing some text, pls read it off the attached photo. Don't move the image off the station's local server. Not a rush job, whenever's fine.
hey quick, the thermal cam in the switchyard captured the relay panel, can u read the trip message on the display? cloud's fine for this. need it like yesterday, outage team's on the phone.

Clause 4, casual version: the provider outlines any mildew patches on leaves visible in the weather station cam with boxes, so we know where they're forming. Images get processed on the vineyard's own hardware and never go off the property.
Intersection cam, Main & 5th: crash reported, box every vehicle and person in the frame so responders know where they are. Keep footage on the roadside unit, no upload. Priority job, now.
Hey, how many tomato trusses are ripe on row 9 in this pic? Give me just the number. Keep the photo on our greenhouse box, and there's no rush.

Hi Sofia, the station out at the Pinot block took a photo of its own display and we need the readings off the screen typed out. Nothing fancy accuracy-wise, a plain read is fine. But could you turn it round ASAP, since the frost call's tonight and the manager wants the numbers? Thanks, Luca
Cleanroom 3 particle counter cam: pls box any fibers or debris showing on the filter so QA can find each spot. Imagery stays in the facility, no offsite processing. Rush it, batch release is on hold.
heya, the gangway cam caught a boarding pass with a half-hidden name, can u read what's printed on it? just keep the pic on the terminal's own server pls.

Clause 10, said simply: the provider marks each inverter cabinet with a scorched or bulging capacitor in our field photos with a box so techs can walk straight to it. We're happy for this to be processed on your remote infrastructure.
Inverter row 4 ping: how many units are showing a red fault LED? Send just the count. Keep the image on the farm's local controller, and a rough read is fine.
Hey, how many suitcases are going round in this picture of carousel 5? Just the number please. Don't need precision, and take your time.

Hi team, a customer's locker code slip got photographed at the kiosk on George St and the print is faded. Can you read the code off it and send me the text? Please treat it as a rush, they're standing at the machine right now. Thanks, Hana
Van 14 cargo cam: pls count the vaccine cartons still on the shelves, number only. Footage doesn't leave the van's onboard box, no uploading. Needs doing right away, delivery window's closing.
yo, how many logs are sitting on the infeed deck in this shot? just the number. need it fast, saw's about to start.

Clause 5, casual edition: the helmet scanner feed at the gate gets checked and the provider works out how many workers are missing hard hats and gives it as a single figure. It's fine to process this on your cloud servers. Decent-but-not-perfect accuracy is acceptable, we're not paying for the fancy model.
OR 4 air sensor cam: box any condensation or mould spots on the ceiling vents so facilities knows which vent to clean. Fine to run it in the cloud. Accuracy has to be tip-top, it's a sterile zone.
Hey, how many motorbikes went under the toll gantry in this batch of frames? Just the number, and take it easy, nobody's waiting on it.

Hi Kenji, could you run the arm-mounted cam images from cell 3 and box every weld spot and missing bolt so we can map them on the chassis? We need this really precise, a miss slips through to the customer. It's a background job though, nobody's waiting, next sprint works. Thanks, Aisha
Light pole on Crown St: pls count how many birds' nests are on the bracket arms in the pole cam frame, just the figure. Accuracy's a must, the council's contractor bills per nest.
hey mate, how many stems has the harvester stacked on the landing in this pic? only need the number. and chop chop, the truck's waiting to load.

Clause 14, plain-talk version: when the runway cam snags a stray tag or placard, the provider reads the printed text and returns it. Processing it off-airfield on your servers is fine. A basic-grade read is acceptable, we're not asking for top-end.
Engine room cam ping: how many gauges are in the red zone on the control panel? Reply with the count only. No need for pinpoint accuracy.
Hey, read the ticket barcode number on this turnstile snap for me. Keep the picture on the stadium's own server, and don't sweat the accuracy, an average read works.

Hi Grace, could you count how many charging bays had cars parked in them in yesterday's overhead photos? Just shoot me the total, no images needed. This is for a slow-burn planning doc, so no rush. Ta, Ben
Crane STS-2 frame: pls count the containers on the vessel's top tier in bay 12, number only. Don't need anything precise, rough is fine, but get it back fast, stow planning is blocked.
hey, the helmet scanner at the east gate grabbed a crowd shot, can you box everyone without a hard hat so I can see who's where? footage stays on the site server tho, it's not going offsite.

Clause 6, casually worded: for gangway cam frames, the operator's service marks any trip hazards, like ropes or loose bags, with boxes showing where they sit. Middling accuracy is acceptable here, we're not after the deluxe option.
Screen door panel, platform 4: pls read the fault text shown on the door display. Image stays on the station's local server. An okay-ish read is enough.
Hey, uh, can you grab the words off that boarding notice board in the gangway photo? Basic accuracy's totally fine, doesn't gotta be perfect.

Hey team, bags keep piling up on the reclaim belt and we need something that'll box every suitcase in the frame and show exactly where each one sits. Please don't cut corners on accuracy, we want the sharpest results you can manage. And yeah, this one's drop-everything, we need it back ASAP. Cheers from the ramp crew!

Wet well at the pump station's clogging again, need a count of the rag balls on the bar screen, just the number pls. Ship the image off to the cloud if that's easier, no worries. Kinda on fire here so rush it.
yo can u read off the container ID painted on the box the crane's holding rn? need it like this second, truckie's waiting lol

Okay so, under this deal the provider's gonna spot every pallet, person and stray carton in the AGV's view and mark where each one sits with a box drawn round it. Accuracy's gotta be top-tier on this, no sloppy guesses allowed. Also, these jobs jump the queue, full stop, we want 'em back immediately.
Heads up, stall cam wants boxes drawn around each teat so the robot arm knows where to latch. Keep all the footage in the barn, nothing leaves the farm. Good-enough accuracy works fine btw.
Hey, how many logs are sitting on the infeed deck in this shot? Just the number, mate. And keep those pics inside the mill, don't go shipping 'em out anywhere.

Hiya, so we've got folks parking in the charging bays and not plugging in, and I wanna pull the plate numbers off the bay snapshots. Otter enclosure cam: need the text off the keeper's whiteboard in frame (feeding times etc). A decent read's plenty, doesn't need to be flawless.
hey quick q, how many cows are lined up in the holding pen by the milking stalls? just gimme a number, but it's gotta be dead-on, no ballparking. need it asap, parlour's about to kick off

Ping from the OR air monitor: the filter snapshot's in, can someone box and pinpoint every speck or clump on it? Cool to send the image off-premises for processing, no issue.
Okay assistant, count how many flare tips are lit in this shot for me, just the figure. Middle-of-the-road accuracy is plenty, and no rush, get to it when you can.

Track scanner snapped the sleeper stamps along the down line, need the date codes read off 'em. Send to offsite servers if that's quicker, we're cool with it. Rush job pls, maintenance crew's on the track now.
hey so the water probe at the salmon pens has this tiny LCD, can you read what's on it from the pic? needs to be super precise tho, one wrong digit on the oxygen level and we'd freak out for nothing

Alright, per this arrangement the drone's flyovers get turned into a straight tally of sheep in each paddock, just a number, nothing else attached. Hey, how many parcels are jammed in the overflow bin at the lockers right now? Just say the number. Go ahead and run it on your servers somewhere, whatever, but hurry, the courier's waiting.

Righto, so the gangway cams gotta spot every passenger, pram and wheelchair crossing and box each one where it is in the frame. None of this footage heads off-site, it stays at the terminal, no exceptions. Plus these requests go straight to the top of the pile, we want results back in a flash.
FYI: flare stack cam grabbed the nameplate on the knockout drum, pls pull the text off it. Keep the image on the platform, nothing goes ashore. Zero rush, get to it whenever.
